promptAsSent:
Use the image_gen tool to generate exactly one image, then stop. Do not write files, run commands or edit anything.

Attached reference images, in order:
Image 1: Geometry/layout authority: envelopes, centers, sizes and holes
Image 2: Species, material and palette identity only; not layout

Use case: sketch-to-render. RESKIN image 1, the authoritative geometry guide, into a transparent sprite sheet of DAMAGED overhead undergrowth for a top-down tactical game. Image 2 is the intact sheet and is the species, material and palette identity: the same six tundra plants in the same places, now shot through and torn. Do not copy its exact pixels; follow image 1's thinned layout.
Preserve image 1 exactly: 1536x1024 canvas, 3 columns x 2 rows at 512px pitch, every silhouette's center, size and envelope. Nothing grows beyond the guide envelope; do not enlarge anything.
Camera STRAIGHT DOWN, orthographic plan view, as image 2.
Order: heath patch, small heath patch, dwarf willow scrub; lichen hummock, sedge tussock bed, spruce seedlings. Each is still standing and still its own plant, but thinned: torn and missing leaf clumps, snapped pale splintered twigs, some browned and scorched leaves, more transparent holes than the intact sheet so ground shows through. The heath keeps its wiry stems; the sedge bed keeps its tussocks, some crushed and frayed; the seedlings keep three separate smaller whorls.
Palette as image 2. Painterly realistic rendering matching image 2. No ground shadow, no soil or snow disc, no debris outside the envelope, no labels, no text, no border. True transparent background including every hole. Keep all six registered to the guide and keep the 3:2 canvas.
